source: RI-CRM01 §2 §3 §4 §5 §6 §9. Race terms are NOT restated here — they are read from game/data/progression/race-reactions.json §guards, which W1-07 owns.

predicate: npc.civ_state advanced to CHALLENGE or ALARM this frame due to the crime's contextWeight
line of sight from npc eye node to player chest node at crime_frame
witness.unidentified_effect: bounty lands as 'person or persons unknown'; guards do not approach you for it, but it counts toward the settlement's alarm state and toward RI-STL01 section 7's S-4 zone memory. IMPLEMENTED, W1-15 round 4 — see unidentified_consequence below for the three consumers and the numbers. Round 3 shipped this sentence with none of it built: the round-3 critic classified all 16 occurrences of `identified` in game/src and found exactly one that changed a decision (a 0.4x multiplier on the same ledger), and wrote 'Being suspected and being wanted are the same state, held at different magnitudes ... the file promises kind.' A number with no consequence is not a mechanic; this is the consequence.

report_chain.principle: A crime does not create a bounty. A REPORT does.

routes.condition: witness within 25 m of any guard, LOS or through <= 1 wall
witness paths to nearest guard within 400 m

routes.note: reports at their next contact with a guard

routes.condition: witness dies, is calmed, is bribed, or the crime was in the Interior jurisdiction

report_chain.fleeing_witness: While reported == false the witness stops their schedule, faces you or the nearest exit, and RUNS. A fleeing witness is legible from across a street, and that legibility is what makes the next thirty seconds a decision.

responses.requirement: reach them, disposition >= 40 after fDispStealing, Speechcraft attempt
responses.effect: witness un-flags; permanent +1 to their knows-something-about-you counter
responses.cost: a persuasion attempt, retryable only once per witness
responses.die_reason: S21 — persuasion's failure is permanent (disposition is lost)

responses.requirement: reach them, gold >= 2 * the bounty they would cause
responses.cost: double the bounty, but no bounty, no guard, no faction hit

report_chain.bribe_note: The bribe is deliberately MORE expensive than the bounty. Paying 2x is only worth it when the bounty is not the real cost — a Legion officer near an expulsion threshold, a faction watching, a player who cannot afford to be KNOWN.

s10_witness_murder.ruling: Seam S10 says you can kill anyone. A crime system that treats witness-murder as an exploit to be patched is fighting its own ruling. So it is supported, it works, and it is PRICED.
s10_witness_murder.design_intent: Killing a witness in an empty room, hiding the body, and walking away WORKS, completely, with zero bounty. That is not a bug. What it costs you: a named person is permanently gone from the world along with their quests, their shop, their dialogue and whatever they knew; four of nine factions keep a roll and will notice a member missing; and you have created a corpse which somebody will find.

guard_ladder_overrides.rule: arrest on sight regardless of threshold
arrest on sight regardless of threshold

arrest.shape: a dedicated RI-DLG04-shaped dialogue with three topics and no timer. NOT a menu overlay.

answers.note: The Souls fight begins and this item's authority ends until it resolves.

insufficient_gold.line: You're {shortfall} short, and I can count. Choose again.
insufficient_gold.rule: It is NEVER hidden — a greyed-out option that does not explain itself is a UI failure, not a design one.

escape_hatches.requirement: rank >= 4 in a faction with standing in that jurisdiction

escape_hatches.effect: reduce the bounty by 40%, not clear it
escape_hatches.die_reason: S21 — a persuasion attempt whose failure is permanent

jail.die_reason: S21 makes a random skill loss DEFENSIBLE (jail is not retryable) — but 'you lose your best social skill' is a punishment a player can understand, resent and plan around, and 'you lost a point of something' is noise. RI-CRM01 §6 rules for legibility.

loss.taken_from: your HIGHEST skill among the six you cannot practise in a cell
loss.tie_break: the skill list order in RI-PRG03 §1

jail.gain_note: Prison teaches exactly two things and this is not a joke — it is the mechanism by which a jail sentence is a CHARACTER EVENT rather than a fine.
jail.time: the world clock advances the full sentence. QUEST TIMERS RUN.

persistence_s6.rule: Bounty is world state under S6. Dying does not pay it, reduce it, or hide it.
A witness who was running to a guard when you died is still running. The report lands while you are at the well.
Items are not dropped on death; only souls are (S6)
and its 180 s timer keeps running

persistence_s6.state: guard AGGRO at the moment of death
persistence_s6.rule: resets to the ladder; the bounty that made them hostile is intact, so they will do it again

die_in_arrest_wakes_in_jail.condition: player dies while an arresting guard is in the arrest interaction or in AGGRO from an arrest, AND the killing blow came from a guard
die_in_arrest_wakes_in_jail.effect: you do NOT respawn at your sapwell. You wake in JAIL, sentence already begun.
die_in_arrest_wakes_in_jail.note: Souls' death rule and Morrowind's justice system meet here and neither loses: it is still a death, it still costs your souls, and the world still did the thing the world does.

mid_fight_accrual.rule: ARBITRATION §1 as amended: crime, witnesses, bounty and faction standing all keep accruing mid-fight. The world does not pause because you drew a weapon.
mid_fight_accrual.batching_note: Queueing crime events during COMBAT and flushing them when the encounter volume clears is invisible in every test except one — the player kills a bystander, keeps fighting, and the writ that should already be void is still honoured for the rest of the fight. bounty_change must fire on the frame the crime happened.

faction_reactions.reacts_to: theft from a Ledger member or warehouse
death_flag count in a settlement you were in
faction_reactions.consequence: not expulsion - they raise their prices and start asking you questions they already know the answers to
+2 disposition per 500 g of Imperial bounty, capped +12

ar3_note: The Deep-Kin row is the item's AR-3 contribution: an Imperial bounty makes an entire region's population like you more, which changes hostile_below_disposition checks, which changes which war-brood camps open hostile — a crime committed in Gideon changing a fight in the Stone Forest.

unidentified_consequence.why: The three promises above, each with a named consumer in the running world, so this block cannot go back to being a `why` string that reads as a specification and functions as a decoration.

guards_do_not_approach.rule: The guard ladder's band is computed from the ATTRIBUTED bounty — CrimeWorld.attributedIn('imperial'), which is the total less everything that landed unattributed — and not from the total. A bounty nobody could pin on you leaves you in band 0 no matter how large it is.
guards_do_not_approach.check: Land two partial reports worth 400 g and the ledger reads 400 while the band reads greeting_only; identify one witness and the band moves.

settlement_alarm.consumer: CrimeWorld.raiseAlarm()/alarmIn(), read by game/src/sim/stealth/system.js#step()'s civilian block
settlement_alarm.rule: Each unattributed report raises the settlement's alarm by alarm_step, capped at 100 and held for alarm_hold_s of play. Every civilian's contextWeight in that settlement is multiplied by 1 + (level/100) * (alarm_context_multiplier_at_100 - 1). A town that keeps losing things to a thief nobody can describe watches harder.
settlement_alarm.why_this_number: alarm_context_multiplier_at_100 is 1.5 because theft.json's own trespass ladder already spends the range 0.0 to 3.0 on contextWeight and a town-wide term must not be able to dominate the room-level one: at full alarm a public street (0.00) is still 0.00 and a private dwelling (2.20) becomes 3.30, which is one notch above the restricted class rather than a new tier.

zone_memory.rule: An unattributed report raises the zone's S-4 memory exactly as a failed search does — baseline alert 25 for 180 s, contextWeight x1.4 for 20 in-game minutes — because it is the same fact about the world: something happened in this room and nobody knows who. It routes to onSearchEnded(zone, frame, false) rather than minting a second decay clock.
zone_memory.requires: p.zone, which had no producer at all before this round. game/src/sim/stealth/system.js#syncPlayerZone() is it.
